description: Obj 32/32A: cell-stage movement runtime observation (dossier docs/analysis/dossiers/cell-movement.md). All rva fields are linked VAs at PE ImageBase 0x400000; the tracer plants at loadBase + (rva - image_base), not at a raw PE RVA. Current static Ghidra evidence identifies the active global operand as 0x016b3c04; the earlier snapshot address text is historical provenance, not an alternate operand. Probe addresses were byte-verified in the GOG 3.1.0.22 executable: instruction-aligned clean prologues, and three bodies match decompiled dossier semantics (0x5158 lock flag, 0x411c player ref, sCellGame global 0x016b3c04, callee FUN_007c4730). Cell-stage reachability is not established: prior zero-event runs are historical, environment-bound negatives, not a current gate expectation. A current human-watched, focused-window run is required to establish Cell reachability; menu/bootstrap probes are controls.
